name: BSL
description: Business Source License a source-available license that restricts commercial use until a specified Change Date, after which the code converts to an open-source license (typically MIT).

name: ISC
description: Permissive open source license functionally equivalent to MIT. Grants free use, modification, and distribution with simple attribution.
